faqs.question: What types of printing services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We print books, registers, test sheets, admission forms, prospectuses, notebooks, diaries, calendars, stickers, labels, and more.

faqs.question: Which file formats do you accept for printing?
faqs.answer: We accept PDF, AI, PSD, INDD, DOC/DOCX, and high-resolution JPG/PNG files. PDF files with CMYK color and 3 mm bleed are preferred for the best print results.

faqs.question: Can I customize the size, paper, and finishing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose the size, paper stock, binding, lamination, and other finishing options to suit your project. Our team can help you select the right specifications.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: Minimum quantities depend on the product and printing method. Tell us what you need and we will confirm the available options for your order.

faqs.question: How long does printing and delivery take?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on the order size, finishing, and delivery location. We will share an estimated production and delivery schedule with your quote.

faqs.question: Can I request a quote before placing an order?
faqs.answer: Of course. Share your product, quantity, size, paper, and finishing requirements, and our team will prepare a quote before you place your order.

servic_section.heading: Our Printing Services

services.title: Register Printing
services.description: School, college, and office registers printed with durable paper.
services.details: We provide long-lasting register printing designed for daily academic and office use. Our registers are printed with clear ruling, strong binding, and premium paper to ensure durability over time.

services.title: Book Printing
services.description: High-quality book printing including textbooks, novels, manuals.
services.details: Our book printing service delivers professional-grade results with excellent paper quality, sharp text, and strong binding. Whether you need educational books or commercial publications, we ensure consistency and accuracy.

services.title: Title & Cover Printing
services.description: Attractive book titles and covers with premium paper.
services.details: We design and print visually appealing book covers using premium materials. Our printing ensures accurate colors, smooth finishing, and a professional look.

services.title: File & Document Printing
services.description: Fast and accurate printing of files, reports, notes, and official documents.
services.details: We offer quick and precise document printing services suitable for academic and professional needs, maintaining clarity and formatting accuracy.

services.title: Book Binding
services.description: Spiral, soft, hard, and thermal binding for books and documents.
services.details: Our binding services provide durability and a professional finish, ensuring your documents remain secure and presentable.

services.title: Bulk Printing
services.description: Cost-effective bulk printing solutions for businesses and institutions.
services.details: We specialize in large-scale printing with consistent quality and competitive pricing, ideal for organizations with high-volume needs.

services.title: Poster Printing
services.description: Large-format posters with vibrant colors and sharp image quality.
services.details: Our poster printing service delivers eye-catching visuals with accurate color reproduction and crisp details.

services.title: Invoice & Receipt Books
services.description: Custom invoice, receipt, and bill books with NCR paper options.
services.details: We print professional invoice and receipt books with clear formatting and optional carbonless (NCR) paper.

services.title: Sticker & Label Printing
services.description: Custom stickers and labels for products, branding, and packaging.
services.details: We create high-quality stickers and labels that stick well and look professional for branding and packaging.

services.title: Calendar Printing
services.description: Wall and desk calendars with customized designs and branding.

services.title: Lamination Services
services.description: Glossy and matte lamination for documents, cards, and posters.

services.title: Cutting & Trimming
services.description: Precision cutting and finishing for printed materials.
